summary: The two-sided acknowledgement check completed, giving the strongest witnessed consequence yet. Receipt f0db8b71047e42df96d3e2f4f581835c resolves both comparisons: with RestoreCommittedLogs on and the restarted node isolated with one committed voter, both that node and the majority side's own leader acknowledged a client write (comparison 0 violated, witness event index 27, both_sides_acknowledged true), while the flag-off control had no leader on the isolated side so only the majority side acknowledged (comparison 1 holds, evaluated event index 29). The question now rests on four complete comparisons with controls in the same executions — configuration loss (witness 15, control 18), minority election (witness 22, control 25), single-side acknowledgement (witness 27, control 29) and two-sided acknowledgement (witness 27, control 29) — and the interpretation is violated with defect_claim asserted: after a restart with this flag the node keeps the snapshot's smaller configuration, its quorum arithmetic follows that stale list, so it can win leadership and answer clients on a minority of the committed configuration, in the worst case concurrently with the majority side's leader acknowledging a different write. A Behavior knowledge entry is promoted for the concurrent acknowledgement with that receipt, joint history covers the four complete executions, and the limits stay explicit: no FSM divergence or lost acknowledged entry is witnessed, every observation is bounded so no frequency or absence is claimed, and the registered gap remains open only on that divergence point, resolved=false.
